title: About the API Client Access Policy

blocks.text: The API client access policies determine the API client's access to specific API resources within set time frames. Administrators can define the policy rules and assign them to the required API clients to prevent unauthorized activity and control access to API resources.
The API client access policy includes the following benefits:

blocks.item: Ensures API usage is limited to approved resources.
Provides API resources availability within specific time frames.

blocks.heading: About the API Client Access Policy Page

blocks.text: On the API Client Access Policy page (Administration > API > API Client Access Policy), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for an API client access policy rule by name.
Add an API client access policy rule.
Select the columns to display in the table and click Apply.
View the list of API client access policy rules. For each policy rule, you can see:
Name: The name of the API client access policy rule. Click name to view details of an API client access policy rule.
API Clients: The list of API clients to which the policy rule is assigned.
Only one policy rule can be assigned to an API client at a time.
Criteria: The API resources and time parameters defined in the policy rule.
Rule Action: The action (Allow or Block) that is defined for the policy rule.
Rule Status: The status (Active or Expired) of the policy rule.
Edit an API client access policy rule.
If you update the policy rule that is associated with the API client, then the access token is also updated. Ensure to use a valid access token.
Delete an API client access policy rule.
You cannot delete the policy rule if any API client is associated with it.
